title: Midnight Windows
description: A quiet song about finding direction after a difficult season.
lyrics:
[Verse]
Streetlights draw a map across the night
Small sparks gather, turning dark to bright

[Chorus]
I find a window in the midnight glow
And take one more brave step to go

title: Small Sparks
description: An uplifting draft about rebuilding confidence.
lyrics:
[Verse]
I keep the lessons, leave the weight behind
Make a little room for what I find

[Chorus]
Small sparks are enough to start a fire
One true note can lift me higher
